title: Rancher installer
description: Configuration for installing Rancher (forked rancher chart). Only fields declared here can be set on a Composition; everything else uses the chart defaults in values.yaml.

hostname.title: Hostname
hostname.description: Fully-qualified DNS name used to reach the Rancher UI/API (must resolve to your ingress).

bootstrapPassword.title: Bootstrap password
bootstrapPassword.description: Initial password for the local 'admin' user. If empty, Rancher generates a random one stored in the 'bootstrap-secret' secret.

replicas.title: Replicas
replicas.description: Number of Rancher server replicas. Use 3 for HA; set to 1 for single-node clusters (kind/minikube).

ingressClassName.title: Ingress class name
ingressClassName.description: IngressClass to use. Leave empty to use the cluster default.

servicePort.title: Ingress backend port
servicePort.description: Backend service port the ingress targets (80 or 443).

source.title: TLS certificate source
source.description: rancher = self-signed via cert-manager; letsEncrypt = public certs via cert-manager; secret = bring your own TLS secret.

secretName.title: TLS secret name
secretName.description: Name of the TLS secret when source is 'secret'.

service.title: Service
service.description: How the Rancher server Service is exposed.

type.title: Service type
type.description: ClusterIP (default; reach Rancher through the Ingress), NodePort or LoadBalancer.

httpsNodePort.title: HTTPS NodePort
httpsNodePort.description: Force the https (443) node port number (only with service.type NodePort/LoadBalancer). Useful on kind to line up with extraPortMappings.

httpNodePort.title: HTTP NodePort
httpNodePort.description: Force the http (80) node port number (only with service.type NodePort/LoadBalancer).

disableHTTP.title: Disable HTTP port
disableHTTP.description: Disable the http (80) port of the Rancher service. Requires ingress.servicePort=443.

letsEncrypt.title: Let's Encrypt
letsEncrypt.description: Only used when ingress.tls.source is letsEncrypt.

email.title: Email
email.description: Contact email used to register the Let's Encrypt account.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Use 'staging' until your config is correct (production limits registrations).

privateCA.title: Private CA
privateCA.description: Set true when the certificate is signed by a private CA (provide the 'tls-ca' secret in cattle-system).

additionalTrustedCAs.title: Additional trusted CAs
additionalTrustedCAs.description: Enable to add your own CA certs via a 'tls-ca-additional' secret.
